wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/tmpclean.sh: #!/bin/zsh
# Reports (and optionally purges) the elephc temp-dir leak, a documented hazard on this machine:
# interrupted suites leave `$TMPDIR/elephc_*` behind and they accumulate until the disk fills.
# Only directories older than 60 minutes are removed, so a live run is never touched.
n=$(find "$TMPDIR" -maxdepth 1 -name 'elephc_*' -type d 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
echo "leaked elephc temp dirs: $n"
du -sh "$TMPDIR" 2>/dev/null | tail -1
if [[ "$1" == "purge" ]]; then
  find "$TMPDIR" -maxdepth 1 -name 'elephc_*' -type d -mmin +60 -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 rm -rf
  echo "purged;
